title: Robotics Approach
content: Kevin's robotics work spans mechanical design, electronics, embedded control, ROS2, computer vision, and AI systems. His portfolio includes gesture-controlled robots, expressive robot heads, robotic arm puppeteering tools, haptic interfaces, and sensor-driven prototypes. A recurring pattern is building the full path from physical hardware to software control: CAD and 3D printing, PCB or microcontroller bring-up, perception with OpenCV or AprilTags, and higher-level control or AI behavior.
